boundary_evidence: PARTIAL PROMOTION. daKpa2Bg_c's contiguous linker run is 0x02117980..0x02117d1c, ten functions (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py). src/actors/daKpa2Bg_c.cpp licenses only the ROM-ascending prefix 0x02117980..0x02117c30 -- eight of them. The two above the boundary, _ZN10daKpa2Bg_c13InitResourcesEv (0x02117c30) and daKpa2Bg_c_classInit (0x02117cdc), keep their own enrolled shards (src/_ZN10daKpa2Bg_c13InitResourcesEv.cpp and src/d_a_kpa2_bg.c) and are not written in the merged source at all.

THE BOUNDARY IS A RELOCATION, NOT A BYTE. Both held-out functions were written in this TU first and both reproduced their cartridge bytes from it: `python tools/tubuild.py verify ov060/daKpa2Bg_c` with all ten licensed reported `byte comparison : 10/10 MATCH`, objisolate clean, reloc-destinations clean; and after the boundary was settled, `python tools/match.py --c src/actors/daKpa2Bg_c.cpp --func _ZN10daKpa2Bg_c13InitResourcesEv --addr 0x02117c30 --size 0xac --module ov060 ...` and the same for daKpa2Bg_c_classInit at 0x02117cdc size 0x40 each printed `MATCHING VERSIONS: 2004/b56`. Nothing about either is unsolved as codegen.

WHAT BLOCKS InitResources: it hands dBgW_KcMbg::SetFile a CLPS block loaded from 0x021115bc. config/arm9/overlays/ov060/relocs.txt records that site as `from:0x02117cd4 kind:load to:0x021115bc module:overlays(8,11,17,28,31,33,37,39,40,41,42,44,46,48,50,51,53,54,57,59)` -- twenty candidate modules, and ov060 makes no unambiguous call to any of them that would narrow it. No config/**/symbols.txt in the tree defines a name for that address, so the reference stays the phantom `func_021115bc` (declared only in include/decl_common.h) and tools/eligible.py rule 5 rejects the file. Its delinks.txt entry is correspondingly the one entry in this run WITHOUT `complete`.

THE TOOL REFUSED THE WIDER RANGE IN THOSE WORDS. `python tools/tubuild.py linkcheck ov060/daKpa2Bg_c -j 16` against the ten-function manifest stopped at phase 1 with: "REFUSED -- the scratch delinks substitution is not safe: entry src/_ZN10daKpa2Bg_c13InitResourcesEv.cpp is NOT `complete` today (dsd serves it from ROM bytes); substituting the TU would change enrollment and byte provenance in the same step".

WHY THE FACTORY IS HELD OUT TOO: daKpa2Bg_c_classInit is the HIGHEST function in the run at 0x02117cdc, with InitResources between it and everything else, so no contiguous `complete` span can reach the factory without also claiming InitResources. src/d_a_kpa2_bg.c stays enrolled and keeps supplying it.

WHY NEITHER IS CARRIED AS deadstrip-duplicate, WHICH WAS TRIED FIRST: tools/objisolate.py only discards a duplicate body whose symbol has VAGUE linkage (STB_LOPROC). An out-of-line member and an extern "C" free function are both STB_GLOBAL, and the production build refused them in those words -- `FAIL src/actors/daKpa2Bg_c.cpp: isolate: compiler-only deadstrip refused: _ZN10daKpa2Bg_c13InitResourcesEv: duplicate deadstrip needs vague linkage, got STB_GLOBAL` (tools/rombuild.py -j16). The destructor pair below the boundary is the opposite case and is why the inline in-class body matters: it is emitted with vague linkage. So the two held-out bodies are simply not written in the merged source, and the file says so where they would have been.

NOTHING IS LOST BY THEIR ABSENCE. With `virtual ~daKpa2Bg_c() {}` inline in the header, this class's key function is Behavior, so src/actors/daKpa2Bg_c.cpp is still the translation unit that emits _ZTV10daKpa2Bg_c, the _ZTI/_ZTS chain and both destructor variants -- exactly the bytes the licensed run has to produce. The eleven compiler_only_output rows below are that emission, each with a canonical ROM home outside every claimed range.

WHAT THE NARROWED RANGE PROVED. `tubuild verify`: 8/8 MATCH, objisolate clean, emission order ROM-ascending. `tubuild linkcheck ov060/daKpa2Bg_c -j 16` -> SCRATCH-LINK-VERIFIED: TU .text range 0x02117980..0x02117c30, 688 bytes, IDENTICAL; module fidelity 106/106 exact; full ROM sha256 d1506e90efae5e2d2cf119926a4ac2a291bd5ca78349d09d5024e1a918c478e8, IDENTICAL to the source-independent stock control. `dsd check symbols --fail` FAILS on 9 error lines, all 9 present in the `linkcheck --baseline` control too (0 new), so they are the tree's and not this TU's -- but that check is NOT green and is not reported as such. Production `python tools/rombuild.py -j16`: 1 compiled, exit 0, intact TU gates PASS, 11,207 source-built functions reproducing / 0 mismatching, module fidelity 106/106 exact, same ROM sha256.

TO CLOSE THE BOUNDARY LATER: disambiguate the cross-overlay load at 0x021115bc so some module's symbols.txt legitimately names the CLPS block, mark src/_ZN10daKpa2Bg_c13InitResourcesEv.cpp `complete`, then move both bodies into this file and license 0x02117980..0x02117d1c as one range. No other source change is needed -- both bodies are known to match from here.
